crossRefs.note: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”
He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved…

parallels.note: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.

translations.web: They gave it to the carpenters and to the builders, to buy cut stone and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
translations.bsb: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to buy dressed stone, as well as timbers for couplings and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to deteriorate.
translations.kjv: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
translations.asv: even to the carpenters and to the builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
